Description.English: Under the influence of upper-level disturbances and the associated unstable airstream, showers are expected to become more frequent in Macao tonight. Showers will be heavy at times, with a few thunderstorms on Saturday (14th Nov) early morning. Weather conditions will improve during the day. The public is advised to pay attention to weather changes and follow the alerts and warnings issued by the DSMG. ( Update Time: 2026-11-13 07H05 )
